messages:
priya_csm: Kicking off Hydranet onboarding. Objective: pilot chat & retrieval on Hosted, evaluate Dedicated if needed. Proposed sync Wed 10/9 9:30am PT. Agenda: intros, success metrics, access (SSO/API), data handoff, infra sizing, enablement plan, risks. Can folks make that time?

noah_cs: I can. I9ll lead enablement docs and post-pilot feedback capture.

sara_se: I9ll own SSO + ingestion. Need sanitized sample + a short list of canonical prompts.

diego_eng: Available. I9ll bench Dedicated options and define smoke tests (p50/p95).

lina_successops: Quick success criteria proposal:
- Core flows pass end-to-end in staging
- Demo accepted by PM + CS lead
- Latency target p50 < 300ms for typical prompts
- Runbook + escalation path in doc
- Post-demo satisfaction >= 7/10

hydra_pm: PM + infra lead can join. We9ll upload a redacted sample (NDJSON, ~30MB) and top-5 user journeys. Legal will be on standby for retention Qs.

priya_csm: Timeline suggestion:
Week 0: Kickoff + discovery
Week 1: Access + staging setup (SSO, keys, sample)
Week 2: Integration + enablement session
Week 3: Pilot (low traffic) + feedback capture
Week 4: Demo + go/no-go

sara_se: Requesting Hydranet IP ranges for allowlist and a service account for test uploads. Also note infra needs 48h lead for allowlist changes.

diego_eng: I9ll run bench Tue/Wed and post numbers in the kickoff doc. Starting pilot config: 1 GPU-equivalent.

lina_successops: Feedback plan: 3-question pulse after pilot + 20-minute follow-up with PM. I9ll add survey draft.

priya_csm: Action owners:
- noah_cs: create kickoff doc + send invite (owner)
- hydra_pm: upload sample + journeys + legal contact (owner)
- sara_se: SSO checklist + ingestion plan (owner)
- diego_eng: Dedicated bench + smoke tests (owner)
- lina_successops: success criteria + feedback survey (owner)
- priya_csm: risk register + 30/60 health check cadence (owner)

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Wed Oct 9 9:30am PT "Hydranet: Redwood Onboarding Kickoff" 50min  Link: https://meet.redwood/hydranet-kickoff

noah_cs: I9ll draft the doc and populate owners by EOD. Please add any pre-reads.

priya_csm: Thanks — flag procurement or legal blockers here early so we can adjust timeline. See you Wed.
